The proposed deal to preserve Muny is also a land-development story.

Austin and UT are discussing an agreement that would transfer Lions Municipal Golf Course to the City while updating the rules for future private development on 190 acres of University-owned Brackenridge land.

The City’s current proposal describes these development limits:

• Buildings capped at 65 feet when viewed from Lake Austin Boulevard
• Impervious cover limited to 75% sitewide
• A 200-foot setback from Lady Bird Lake

The broader tract already includes UT student housing and other developed land. These negotiations concern the framework for what comes next—not a newly approved apartment project or a confirmed number of homes.

Why it matters locally: Preserving the golf course and setting development rules nearby could shape a significant part of West Austin. Housing details, infrastructure and the eventual mix of uses deserve attention as the proposal moves forward.

The amended agreement is scheduled for City Council consideration November 19. If approved, the regulating plan would return through commissions and Council in spring 2027.

The land transfer and future development rules are still proposed.

Sources: City of Austin, October 14, 2026 announcement and Brackenridge Tract project page.
